description: Unit tests for media GPU Mac video format utilities, including format extension creation, color space handling, and format description parsing.

methods.name: GetStrValue
methods.description: Converts CFDictionary value for a key to UTF8 string.

methods.name: GetCFStrValue
methods.description: Retrieves CFStringRef value for a key from CFDictionary.

methods.name: GetIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves integer value for a key from CFDictionary.

methods.name: GetBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves boolean value for a key from CFDictionary.

methods.name: GetDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves data as span from CFDictionary for a key.

methods.name: GetNestedDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves nested data span from CFDictionary given two keys.

methods.name: CreateCVImageBuffer
methods.description: Creates a CVImageBuffer with specified VideoColorSpace.

methods.name: CreateFormatDescription
methods.description: Creates a CMFormatDescription with specified primaries, transfer, and matrix.

methods.name: ToBT709_APPLE
methods.description: Converts gfx::ColorSpace to BT709_APPLE color space.

methods.name: AssertHasDefaultHDRMetadata
methods.description: Checks if CFDictionary has default HDR metadata values.

methods.name: AssertHasNoHDRMetadata
methods.description: Checks if CFDictionary has no HDR metadata.
